title: NexKeyRuntime ProductData
description: Self-signed blob generated by the MCNexus backoffice and embedded in a plugin's source. Contains no secret — only a public keyring and a base URL. Envelope shape mirrors the activation certificate: `payload`/`signature` are base64url, `signature` is the Ed25519 signature of the exact decoded `payload` bytes, verified against one of the keys inside the payload's own `keyring` (self-signed).

keyId.description: Must match one entry in the decoded payload's keyring.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) over the decoded payload bytes.

payload.description: Decoded, self-verified payload — mirrors MCBackend/shared/licensing/productData.ts's buildProductDataBlob output.

baseUrl.description: sdkGateway origin for this environment, e.g. https://sdk.mcnexus.app.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key — decodes to exactly 32 bytes.

keyring.description: 1 to 4 entries — active and not-yet-pruned retired keys for this tenant. Never contains a private key.
